content.title: What's Going On With Rail Vision Stock On Friday?
content.summary: Rail Vision Ltd. (NASDAQ:RVSN) saw its shares rise on Friday after announcing a major achievement in railway safety. The company revealed it had received certification approval for the installation of its MainLine Systems on Israel Railways’ passenger locomotives. This milestone triggers a $300,000 milestone payment and positions Rail Vision for potential future volume procurement from Israel Railways.
